theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiDens_lower_bound_of_deriv
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (K ρ₁ : ℝ) (V : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < K → MonotoneOn V (Ioo 0 ρ₁) → (∀ ρ ∈ Ioo 0 ρ₁, 0 < V ρ) → (∀ᵐ ρ ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ρ ∈ Ioo 0 ρ₁ → ∃ d : ℝ, HasDerivAt V d ρ ∧ V ρ ^ ((n : ℝ) / (n + 1)) ≤ K * d) → ∀ ρ ∈ Ioo 0 ρ₁, (ρ / ((n + 1) * K)) ^ (n + 1) ≤ V ρ
